# Winifred Tolley

[Conservative](../codex/factions.md#conservative)

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Winifred Tolley possesses a healthy, circular, pink-and-white complexion and blonde hair styled into a rigid, tiny bun with a firm elastic band. She has gentle, cheerful, and dreadful brown eyes.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR P35](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0035)_

## Personality

Winifred Tolley possesses a deeply compassionate nature despite her sharp, critical tongue, particularly directed in her strong disdain for men. Unbothered by nerves and grounded in pragmatism, she yields to outcomes only when certain they are inevitable. Outside of her dread of [Methodists](../codex/factions.md#methodist), she takes pleasure in reading newspaper death notices and possesses exceptional stitching skills, alongside a celebrated history of baking award-winning lemon pies.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P38](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P26](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P35](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P3](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0003), +5 more_

## History

Miss Winifred Tolley spent eight years as an only child, missing having siblings, until her younger brother was born. After her mother passed away before her brother reached his third birthday, she served as both a sister and a mother to him. In her earlier life, she helped construct a church at [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Agnes](../codex/places.md#agnes) alongside other women and won an award for lemon pies at the [Port Marlow](../codex/places.md#port-marlow) [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). Later living in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), Miss Winifred frequently visited [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), sharing her sharp, opinionated views on neighbors, local gossip, ministers, and local history. During these visits, she shared the tragic background of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) Vane's family and later brought news that journalist [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) would be staying in the village. After a medical trip to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) revealed that Lorna's husband was actually his cousin [Laurence Vane](../character/laurence.md), Miss Winifred discussed the revelation with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and suggested that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) notify Adrian of Lorna's freedom. Later, Miss Winifred approved of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) staying with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) during Adrian's visit, and she subsequently announced her own upcoming marriage to [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P1](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P9](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P37](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0037), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P39](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0039), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P57](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0057), +26 more_

## Quotes

> "She has altered considerably of late. Her laughter and jesting resemble those of a young girl, and based on what she says, I deduce she visits this place quite frequently."
>
> — Winifred Tolley — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P25](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0025)

> "MR. Fiske, my lone brother passed away fifteen years back, and I’ve taken on no new ones since then. Regarding my Christian faith, I trust and believe I possessed it while you were still a toddler wearing petticoats."
>
> — Winifred Tolley — [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P7](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0007)

> "Nell, are you trying to say that the rumors I’ve been hearing are factual—that Dr. Carrow informed Lorna that Rufus can be healed, and that she intends to bring him to Montreal so he can undergo surgery?"
>
> — Winifred Tolley — [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P32](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0032)

> "Rufus Vane received the harm that resulted in his current state during a drunken brawl. His fate is DESERVED. It was inflicted upon him as a retribution. The doctor, I don’t believe, has any right to meddle with God’s visitations."
>
> — Winifred Tolley — [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P46](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0046)

> "Now, you don't need to call me Miss Winifred, my dear Nell. EVERYONE would have come to the identical conclusion. Should the physicians in Montreal succeed in transforming Rufus Vane into a sensible person, they are truly remarkable."
>
> — Winifred Tolley — [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P4](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--winifred-tolley.md)

Winifred is a friend to Adrian, remaining fond of him even while penalizing his overly grandiose manner of speaking. She assists him by driving him to Nell's house, though she frequently cuts through emotional moments with her pragmatic attitude. She also approves of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) staying with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) during Adrian's visits to the area.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), +9 more_

- Friend of — likes him despite penalizing his grandiloquent speech  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P25](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0025)</sub>

### [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lorna-vane--winifred-tolley.md)

Winifred acts as a close friend and steadfast supporter to [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md). Although she fiercely opposes a decision regarding Rufus Vane's surgery and angrily confronts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over it, she ultimately accepts Lorna's final choice. She also approves of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) temporarily moving in with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) while Adrian visits.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P30](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P3](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0003), +5 more_

- Friend of — close friend and supporter  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P30](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P3](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0003), +1 more</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--winifred-tolley.md)

Winifred and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are friendly neighbors who regularly spend time together over tea, newspapers, and village stories. Winifred confides the tragic history of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) Vane's family to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), which inspires [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to become Lorna's friend. Their gatherings often feature Winifred's opinionated commentaries, which she delivers fully aware when others are listening.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P1](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P9](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), +15 more_

- Friend of — friendly tea companions and neighbors  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P78](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0078), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P12](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0012)</sub>

### [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/uncle-saul--winifred-tolley.md)

Winifred and Captain Saul share a long-standing relationship marked by companionship and rivalry. They frequently exchange opinionated debates, gossip, and sharp banter regarding church politics, theology, and local feuds during joint visits and holiday gatherings. [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) sometimes deliberately baits her during these exchanges, though they continue to visit mutual friends together.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P5](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P7](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0007), +8 more_
